programme.desc: The follow-up to "Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone" finds young wizard Harry Potter and his friends, Ron and Hermione, facing new challenges during their second year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry as they try to discover a dark force that is terrorizing the school. - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint (Adventure, Children, Fantasy, Movie)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
programme.desc: Harry Potter's third year at Hogwarts starts off badly when he learns deranged killer Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban prison and is bent on murdering the teenage wizard. While Hermione's cat torments Ron's sickly rat, causing a rift among the trio, a swarm of nasty Dementors is sent to protect the school from Black. A mysterious new teacher helps Harry learn to defend himself, but what is his secret tie to Sirius Black? - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint (Adventure, Children, Fantasy, Movie)

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Don't be ridiculous! When it comes to Internet videos run amok, however, the more zany, unbelievable and downright dangerous the clips are, the greater the chance they'll be shown on this series. It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." It's sure to be seriously ridiculous. - Rob Dyrdek, Sterling Brim (Comedy, Entertainment, Reality, Show)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
programme.desc: During Harry's fourth year at Hogwarts a competition will be held between three schools of wizardry, and contestants will be magically chosen for the very dangerous event. - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint (Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
programme.desc: Now in his fifth year at Hogwarts, Harry learns that many in the wizarding community do not know the truth of his encounter with Lord Voldemort. Cornelius Fudge, Minister of Magic, appoints his toady, Dolores Umbridge, as Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher, for he fears that professor Dumbledore will take his job. But her teaching is deficient and her methods, cruel, so Harry prepares a group of students to defend the school against a rising tide of evil. - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint (Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince (New)

Though Harry suspects there are new dangers lurking within the castle walls, Dumbledore is more intent than ever on preparing the young wizard for the final battle with Voldemort. Teenage hormones run rampant through Hogwarts, presenting a different sort of danger. Love may be in the air, but tragedy looms and Hogwarts may never be the same again. - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint (Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1 (New)

programme.title: Dust Bunny
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Aurora asks a hit man to kill the monster she believes ate her entire family. To protect her, he'll need to battle an onslaught of assassins while accepting the fact that some monsters are real. (Movie)

programme.title: The Devil Is Busy
programme.desc: Tracii works to ensure the safety of women seeking abortions in the face of new restrictions, following the staff who continue to provide a range of medical services in an environment where clinics often face daily threats of danger. (Movie)

programme.title: Generation Por Que?
programme.desc: A woman pursues her acting dreams in New York while enduring her very Cuban and conservative parents. (Movie)

programme.title: House of the Dragon - Queen's Landing
programme.desc: Alicent risks everything to fulfill her end of the bargain; Rhaenyra must decide whether the Iron Throne is worth the cost. (Series)

programme.title: Lurker
programme.desc: A retail employee infiltrates the inner circle of an artist on the verge of stardom. As he gets closer to the budding music star, access and proximity become a matter of life and death. (Movie)

programme.title: John Adams - Join or Die
programme.desc: After the Boston Massacre, John Adams agrees to serve as defense attorney for the accused British soldiers; several years later, he joins the Continental Congress. (Series)

programme.title: John Adams - Independence
programme.desc: Adams nominates George Washington to lead the newly formed Continental Army; Thomas Jefferson drafts the Declaration of Independence; Congress votes to declare independence from England. (Series)

programme.title: John Adams - Don't Tread on Me
programme.desc: Adams and Jefferson visit France to gain financial and military support for America's Revolutionary War effort; Adams falls victim to an illness. (Series)

programme.title: John Adams - Reunion
programme.desc: John and Abigail reunite in Paris; he goes to London as America's first minister to Britain, then must deal with family concerns upon his return to Boston. (Series)

programme.title: John Adams - Unite or Die
programme.desc: Adams becomes the country's first vice president; the ongoing conflict between the British and the French strains Adams' friendship with Jefferson; Adams is elected president in 1796. (Series)

programme.title: John Adams - Unnecessary War
programme.desc: President Adams tries desperately to keep the nation out of war; Adams disowns his alcoholic son, Charles; Jefferson claims the presidency after Adams fails to win a second term. (Series)

programme.title: John Adams - Peacefield
programme.desc: While in retirement, Adams begins to write his memoirs, corresponds with Jefferson after a series of personal tragedies, and lives to see his son John Quincy become president. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - Currahee
programme.desc: A rivalry blazes between Lt. Sobel and a junior officer who has earned the respect of the men in Easy Company. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - Day of Days
programme.desc: Thousands of paratroopers cross the English Channel to France on D-Day; Lt. Winters leads an attack on a fortified German artillery position. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - Carentan
programme.desc: Easy Company sustains casualties while waging battle in Normandy; Pvt. Blithe has trouble adjusting to combat; the company returns to England. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - Replacements
programme.desc: A fresh group of paratroopers joins Easy Company shortly before it parachutes into German-occupied Holland; the company has to retreat when it meets a superior force. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - Crossroads
programme.desc: Winters leads a dangerous mission on a Dutch dike; although ill-equipped, Easy Company races to help hold the Allied line in the Ardennes Forest. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - Bastogne
programme.desc: Easy Company spends Christmas in the trenches while trying to hold the line in the forest outside Bastogne, Belgium. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - The Breaking Point
programme.desc: After taking Bastogne, Belgium, the company moves on to the town of Foy, where many lives are lost as a result of Lt. Dike's incompetence. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - The Last Patrol
programme.desc: Lt. Jones leads a patrol across a river to take enemy prisoners, but the loss of a paratrooper leads Winters to refuse to send another patrol the next night. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - Why We Fight
programme.desc: Easy Company enters Germany and discovers an abandoned Nazi concentration camp occupied by emaciated prisoners, just as the local citizens learn that Hitler is dead. (Series)

programme.title: Band of Brothers - Points
programme.desc: After capturing Eagle's Nest, Hitler's mountaintop fortress, the men of Easy Company face deployment to the Pacific. (Series)

programme.title: Architecton
programme.desc: A hypnotic, propulsive odyssey through the foundations of the modern world, following mountains as they are turned into concrete and buildings as they are turned into rubble. (Movie)

programme.title: House of the Dragon - Queen's Landing
programme.desc: Alicent risks everything to fulfill her end of the bargain; Rhaenyra must decide whether the Iron Throne is worth the cost. (Series)

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Escaping postwar Europe, a visionary architect arrives in America to rebuild his life. On his own in a strange new country, a wealthy industrialist recognizes his talent -- but power and legacy comes at a heavy cost. (Movie)

programme.title: The Great Lillian Hall
programme.desc: Broadway actress Lillian Hall pours her heart and soul into preparing for her next big role but finds herself blindsided by confusion and forgetfulness. She strives to make it to opening night while holding on to her fading memories and identity. (Movie)

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: Beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform at the Talk of the Town nightclub in 1968. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. (Movie)

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Young Bob Dylan arrives in New York with his guitar and revolutionary talent. Forming his most intimate relationships during his rise to fame, he grows restless with the folk movement, making a controversial choice that reverberates worldwide. (Movie)

programme.title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
programme.desc: Author A.A. Milne finds inspiration from his son to write Winnie-the-Pooh and The House at Pooh Corner in the 1920s. His family soon becomes swept up in the success of the books, while the tales bring hope and comfort to postwar England. (Movie)

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: While grappling with the changes brought by middle age, a filmmaker (Ben Stiller) and his wife (Naomi Watts) find their stagnant lives reinvigorated by their friendship with a couple of twentysomething hipsters. (Movie)

programme.title: Miss You, Love You
programme.desc: A blunt, grieving widow is forced to plan her husband's funeral with a total stranger: her estranged son's assistant. (Movie)

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Emily Brontë's gothic heroine Cathy (Merle Oberon) loves stable boy Heathcliff (Laurence Olivier) but marries squire Edgar (David Niven). (Movie)

programme.title: "Wuthering Heights"
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England. (Movie)

programme.title: The Substance
programme.desc: Fading actress Elisabeth Sparkle becomes distressed when her chauvinistic boss fires her from her aerobics show. She soon injects herself with a mysterious serum that promises a younger, better version of herself, but things go horribly wrong. (Movie)

programme.title: The Strangers
programme.desc: Three masked assailants terrorize a young couple (Liv Tyler, Scott Speedman) in a romantic getaway to a remote cottage. (Movie)

programme.title: The Blair Witch Project
programme.desc: A filmmaking crew (Heather Donahue, Michael C. Williams, Joshua Leonard) hikes into Maryland's Black Hills Forest seeking clues about a legendary witch. (Movie)

programme.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
programme.desc: When a townie takes collegians on an overnight tour in Burkittsville, Md., they awake to chaos and have no memory of sleeping. (Movie)

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.desc: The story of the Targaryen civil war with King Viserys I Targaryen's children battling for control of the Iron Throne. (Series)

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: A man who believes he has put his mysterious past behind him cannot stand idly by when he meets a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters. (Movie)

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. (Movie)

programme.title: The Equalizer 3
programme.desc: Finding himself at home in Southern Italy, former operative Robert McCall soon discovers his new friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall becomes their protector by taking on the mafia. (Movie)

programme.title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
programme.desc: Explore the rise of a boundary-pushing, sex-positive, cable-access pioneer who became an accidental AIDS-era lifeline and First Amendment fighter; at 70, with 600 shows behind her, she considers her place in the history she created. (Series)

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited. (Movie)

programme.title: Insidious: The Red Door
programme.desc: Josh Lambert heads east to drop his son, Dalton, off at school. However, Dalton's college dream soon becomes a living nightmare when the repressed demons of his past suddenly return to haunt them both. (Movie)

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
programme.desc: A sudden attack by Wulf, a ruthless Dunlending lord, forces Helm Hammerhand and his people to make a daring last stand in the ancient stronghold of the Hornburg. Finding herself in a desperate situation, Helm's daughter must lead the resistance. (Movie)

programme.title: Ice Age: Continental Drift
programme.desc: Scrat's pursuit of an infernal acorn has world-changing consequences for Manny (Ray Romano), Diego (Denis Leary) and Sid (John Leguizamo). (Movie)

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Po must unlock secrets of his past in order to defeat a villain who plans to wipe out kung fu and conquer China. (Movie)

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
programme.desc: On the run from a French animal-control officer (Frances McDormand), Alex (Ben Stiller) and friends (Chris Rock, David Schwimmer) hide out in a traveling circus, where they perform death-defying tricks and make some new friends. (Movie)

programme.title: The Mystery of D.B. Cooper
programme.desc: Unravelling the mystery surrounding D.B. Cooper, who boarded a Northwest Orient Airlines plane in November 1971 and hijacked the flight while it was still on the tarmac. (Movie)

programme.title: Dear Ms.: A Revolution in Print
programme.desc: A deep dive into the storied and complex legacy of "Ms." magazine through the lens of some of its covers. (Movie)

programme.title: The Welcome Table (New)
programme.desc: Investigation into the impact of the ecological disaster on everyday people's lives by looking at the intersection of climate and immigration. (Series)

programme.title: The Batman
programme.desc: Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues. As the scale of the perpetrator's plans become clear, he must bring justice to the abuse of power and corruption that plagues the metropolis. (Movie)

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: A man who believes he has put his mysterious past behind him cannot stand idly by when he meets a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters. (Movie)

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. (Movie)

programme.title: The Equalizer 3
programme.desc: Finding himself at home in Southern Italy, former operative Robert McCall soon discovers his new friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall becomes their protector by taking on the mafia. (Movie)

programme.title: This Is Spinal Tap
programme.desc: An American filmmaker records the demise of a fictitious band of aging British metalheads in a mockumentary. (Movie)

programme.title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
programme.desc: Documentarian Marty DiBergi follows Spinal Tap as they prepare for a reunion concert. Joined by Paul McCartney and Elton John, they wrestle with their checkered past to put on a show that they hope will solidify their place in rock 'n' roll history. (Movie)

programme.title: The Lighthouse
programme.desc: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s. (Movie)

programme.title: Boys Go to Jupiter
programme.desc: Billy 5000, a teenage gig worker with a rise-and-grind mindset, aims to make $5,000. His quest is derailed by a gelatinous alien's appearance. (Movie)

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: When his dad decides it's time for some father-son bonding, Greg Heffley pretends to have a job at a ritzy country club, so his vacation won't be ruined. (Movie)

programme.title: The Spectacular Now
programme.desc: An innocent, bookish teenager begins dating the charming, freewheeling high-school senior who awoke on her lawn after a night of heavy partying. (Movie)

programme.title: The Dark Wizard - The Death Consequence
programme.desc: Dean Potter connects with a community of like-minded people seeking the sport's freedom and adrenaline; Dean's restless energy compels him to pioneer new ascents and forge new world records. (Series)

programme.title: The Dark Wizard - Dying to Flying
programme.desc: Dean struggles with his inner demons but seems to find relief through death-defying feats cultivating a devoted following drawn to his rebellious antihero image; but soon, a new climber emerges and threatens to eclipse Dean's dominance. (Series)

programme.title: The Dark Wizard - This is Art, This is Spirituality
programme.desc: The rivalry between Dean and Alex Honnold intensifies as both climbers vie to be the first to free solo a route on the 3000-foot El Capitan; Dean alienates his inner circle and accepts a dangerous career opportunity in China. (Series)

programme.title: The Dark Wizard - Transcending Human Limitations
programme.desc: With a new relationship grounding him, Dean regains emotional stability and his long-held dream of flight comes to fruition when he immerses himself in the cutting-edge world of wingsuit flying. (Series)

programme.title: Marty Supreme
programme.desc: Marty Mauser, a wily hustler with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness. (Movie)

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Annihilation

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Badger State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Palmetto State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Buckeye State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Ocean State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Bay State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Magnolia State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Tar Heel State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The North Star State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The District (New)
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's cruising from east to west for a taste of Asian and Americana; in Washington, DC, he visits a joint serving knockout dumplings and ramen; in Ocean City, NJ, he hits up a pizza parlor with cheeseburger and chicken vodka pies. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Bluegrass State (New)
programme.desc: On this trip, Guy Fieri is checking out fried bologna and veggie burgers in Louisville, KY, and brunch staples at a diner-restaurant mashup in Portland, OR. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Aloha State (New)
programme.desc: Guy cruises Maui, Hawaii, with his buddy Chef Reno Henriques for real-deal regional favorites, fresh food truck fare and St. Louis-style barbecue. (Cooking, Travel, Reality)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Old Dominion State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Treasure State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Beehive State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The Lone Star State (New)

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - The First State (New)

programme.desc: A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data (Brent Spiner), takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface. - Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Romance)

programme.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. - Kate Bosworth, Topher Grace, Josh Duhamel, Nathan Lane, Sean Hayes (Romance, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Shaolin Soccer
programme.desc: All his life, an ordinary young man (Stephen Chow) has been treated like dirt. Still, he's never given up believing that all the world's problems could be solved with a little kung fu. So he's teaming up with a band of misfits - six friends who were kung fu masters in their youth - to form a soccer team that only he believes has a chance to win a $1 million grand prize. Together, they're going to apply their hidden talents to a whole new game -- and soccer will never be the same. - Stephen Chow, Zhao Wei, Patrick Tse, Cecilia Cheung, Karen Mok (Family, Comedy, Action)

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Stephen Collins, Persis Khambatta (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination. - James Marsden, Jim Carrey, Tika Sumpter, Natasha Rothwell, Adam Pally (Family, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Son of Rambow
programme.desc: In the 1980s England, schoolboys Will Proudfoot and Lee Carter meet by chance in a hallway. Though the boys are polar opposites, Lee asks Will to help him make a homemade action movie, inspired by Sylvester Stallone's hit, "Rambo: First Blood." Will, who lives in a strict religious environment, is only too happy to oblige his new friend. - Bill Milner, Will Poulter, Jules Sitruk, Jessica Stevenson, Neil Dudgeon (Comedy)

programme.title: Boys and Girls
programme.desc: Ryan and Jennifer are opposites who definitely do not attract. At least that's what they always believed. When they met as twelve-year-olds, they disliked one another. When they met again as teenagers, they loathed each other. But when they meet in college, the uptight Ryan and the free-spirited Jennifer find that their differences bind them together and a rare friendship develops. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Claire Forlani, Jason Biggs, Amanda Detmer, Heather Donahue (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Stephen Collins, Persis Khambatta (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When gigantic robots attack New York City, "Sky Captain" (Jude Law) uses his private air force to fight them off. His ex-girlfriend, reporter Polly Perkins (Gwyneth Paltrow), has been investigating the recent disappearance of prominent scientists. Suspecting a link between the global robot attacks and missing men, Sky Captain and Polly decide to work together. They fly to the Himalayas in pursuit of the mysterious Dr. Totenkopf (Laurence Olivier), the mastermind behind the robots. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Angelina Jolie, Giovanni Ribisi, Michael Gambon (Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction, Action)

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Ignacio (Jack Black), or Nacho to his friends, works as a cook in the Mexican monastery where he grew up. The monastery is home to a host of orphans whom Nacho cares for deeply, but there is not much money to feed them properly. Nacho decides to raise money for the children by moonlighting as a Lucha Libre wrestler with his partner Esqueleto (Héctor Jiménez), but since the church forbids Lucha, Nacho must disguise his identity. - Jack Black, Ana de la Reguera, Héctor Jiménez, Richard Montoya, Peter Stormare (Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: A smart high-school student with his heart set on going to Stanford is horrified when his guidance counselor accidentally sends the wrong transcript with his college application. He spends the rest of the film trying to prove that he's actually a good student with a terrific grade-point average. - Colin Hanks, Jack Black, Catherine O'Hara, Schuyler Fisk, John Lithgow (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up. - Matthew McConaughey, Steve Zahn, Penélope Cruz, Lambert Wilson, Glynn Turman (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: For Rod Kimball (Andy Samberg), performing stunts is a way of life, even though he is rather accident-prone. Poor Rod cannot even get any respect from his stepfather, Frank (Ian McShane), who beats him up in weekly sparring matches. When Frank falls ill, Rod devises his most outrageous stunt yet to raise money for Frank's operation -- and then Rod will kick Frank's butt. - Andy Samberg, Jorma Taccone, Bill Hader, Danny R. McBride, Isla Fisher (Comedy, Action)

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Living in exile on the planet Vulcan, the ragtag former crew of the USS Enterprise steal a starship after receiving a planetary distress call from Earth: a space probe has entered into orbit around Earth, disabled global power on the planet and evaporated the oceans. Captain Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the rest of the officers travel back in time to retrieve now-extinct humpback whales, which Spock has deduced will communicate with the probe and send it away from Earth. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Catherine Hicks, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents. - Rod Steiger, Jeff Saumier, Ray Aranha, Mark Camacho, Jane Wheeler (Drama)

programme.title: Imagine That
programme.desc: Like many busy professionals, Evan Danielson (Eddie Murphy) is so focused on his career that quality time with his young daughter, Olivia (Yara Shahidi), has fallen by the wayside. When an important promotion is suddenly within reach, stressed-out Evan starts to fall apart while trying to fend off his company rival (Thomas Haden Church). But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems. - Eddie Murphy, Thomas Haden Church, Yara Shahidi, Nicole Ari Parker, Ronny Cox (Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama)

programme.title: The Boys Are Back
programme.desc: After the untimely passing of his second wife, Joe (Clive Owen) must deal with his grief as he strives to find a way to raise his sons alone. The boys, Artie and Harry, are trying to cope with their own emotional baggage, so the three decide to throw convention to the wind and live by the words "just say yes." When things go wrong, Joe must find a way to behave more like a parent while maintaining the joys of a more-carefree life. - Clive Owen, Emma Booth, Laura Fraser, George MacKay, Nicholas McAnulty (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Monster Trucks
programme.desc: Looking for any way to get away from the life and town he was born into, Tripp (Lucas Till), a high school senior, builds a monster truck from bits and pieces of scrapped cars. After an accident at a nearby oil-drilling site displaces a strange and subterranean creature with a taste and a talent for speed, Tripp may have just found the key to getting out of town with a most unlikely friend. - Lucas Till, Jane Levy, Rob Lowe, Danny Glover, Barry Pepper (Children, Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Comedy)

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. - Noah Ringer, Dev Patel, Nicola Peltz, Jackson Rathbone, Shaun Toub (Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Adventures of Tintin
programme.desc: While shopping at an outdoor market, young reporter Tintin (Jamie Bell), accompanied by his faithful dog, Snowy, buys a model of an old ship called the Unicorn. A shady character named Sakharine (Daniel Craig) and later an American named Barnaby (Joe Starr) try to buy the model from him, but Tintin refuses. The lad discovers that the ship contains a clue about a hidden treasure, but before he can locate it, Tintin is kidnapped and given over to the custody of drunken Capt. Haddock (Andy Serkis). (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Mystery)

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon who has lived as a sheltered family pet finds himself in the grip of an identity crisis. Rango wonders how to stand out when it is his nature to blend in. When he accidentally winds up in a frontier town called Dirt, he takes the first step on a transformational journey as the town's new sheriff. Though at first Rango only role-plays, a series of thrilling situations and outrageous encounters forces him to become a real hero. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Bad News Bears
programme.desc: Morris Buttermaker is a burned-out minor league baseball player who loves to drink and can't keep his hands to himself. His long-suffering lawyer arranges for him to manage a local Little League team, and Buttermaker soon finds himself the head of a rag-tag group of misfit players. Through unconventional team-building exercises and his offbeat coaching style, Buttermaker helps his hapless Bears prepare to meet their rivals, the Yankees. - Billy Bob Thornton, Greg Kinnear, Marcia Gay Harden, Sammi Kane Kraft, Ridge Canipe (Comedy)

programme.title: Pawn Stars - Top Secret
programme.desc: S2E23 - Top-secret maps and battle plans for Iwo Jima; the Old Man and Chumlee look to buy a 1967 Ford F-100; Corey and Chumlee have the chance to buy an 1860s ore cart. (Reality, Auction, History)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - The Beginning
programme.desc: S1E1 - In September 1939, Germany invades Poland, setting the stage for the most destructive war in history. (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Blitz
programme.desc: S1E2 - After toppling the Netherlands and Belgium, Nazi Germany pushes further west; the Allies scramble to support France as Churchill is forced to defend Britain from the skies and FDR rushes to mobilize wartime production. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Barbarossa
programme.desc: S1E3 - Examine the story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, the largest and costliest land offensive in human history. (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Pearl Harbor
programme.desc: S1E4 - Japan escalates their war in China, drawing increasing U.S. sanctions and widespread outrage; driven by resource shortages and military ideology, Japan attacks Pearl Harbor in a move that reshapes the course of World War II. (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - The War at Sea
programme.desc: S1E5 - Examine how America's battle to control the seas against the German U-boats in the Atlantic and Japan's navy in the Pacific turns the tide of the war. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Guadalcanal
programme.desc: S1E6 - After the attack on Pearl Harbor, Japanese forces sweep across Southeast Asia; on Guadalcanal, United States Marines are given the bloody task of stopping their relentless advance. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Darkness Falls
programme.desc: S1E7 - As Hitler's reach extends beyond Germany and darkness descends on Europe, his hateful rhetoric leads to anti-Jewish persecution and ultimately, genocide. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Operation Torch
programme.desc: S1E8 - The first joint U.S.-British offensive of the war, thousands of inexperienced U.S. troops and their untested leader Eisenhower, face off against the hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Field Marshal Erwin Rommel. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: S1E9 - Behind the fierce frontline clashes of WWII, a hidden battle rages - one of espionage, deception, and codebreaking; in rural England, a group of brilliant academics work to crack Germany's unbreakable Enigma Code and change the course of the war. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Stalingrad
programme.desc: S1E10 - In Operation Blue, the German Army fights to take Soviet oil fields and the city of Stalingrad, becoming one of the deadliest battles ever fought and a major turning point on the Eastern Front. - Tom Hanks (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Italy
programme.desc: S1E11 - The Allies hope to quickly penetrate the Nazi Reich via Italy but instead endure a months-long slog with devastating results. (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks - Battle for the Skies
programme.desc: S1E12 - Allied air forces engage in a fierce and costly battle with the German Luftwaffe over the skies of Europe. (Documentary, History, War)

programme.title: Ralph Lauren's American Icons (New)
programme.desc: Explores legendary designer Ralph Lauren's curation of a collection of 13 United States Postal Service stamps honoring iconic American imagery. Grounded by an intimate interview with his son, David Lauren, and never-before-seen photographs and films from the Ralph Lauren archives. (Special, Documentary)

programme.title: George Washington: Father of His Country (New)
programme.desc: George Washington's journey from loyal British subject to victorious commander and first president of a revolutionary new nation is a lesson in leadership that's endured for 250 years. (Special, History)

programme.title: Hidden Heroes: The Nisei Soldiers of WWII
programme.desc: The unsung story of America's Nisei warriors of WWII, the sons of Japanese immigrants who volunteered by the thousands after Pearl Harbor and served in a segregated regiment to fight in some of the bloodiest battles of WWII. (Special, History)

programme.title: Navy SEALs: America's Secret Warriors - Part 1
programme.desc: S1E1 - The history of the SEALs' predecessors in World War II and the Korean War and their evolution into elite warriors, fighting in the jungles of Vietnam and executing secret missions in Panama and Grenada; the formation of SEAL Team 6. (Documentary, Military, Reality, American history, War)

programme.title: Navy SEALs: America's Secret Warriors - Part 2
programme.desc: S1E2 - The SEALs become the tip of the spear in the War on Terror, executing daily raids in Afghanistan and Iraq as well as high-profile missions, such as the rescue of Capt. Richard Phillips from pirates and the raid on Osama bin Laden's compound. (Documentary, Military, Reality, American history, War)

programme.title: The Food That Built America - Holiday Treats
programme.desc: S4E2 - The top-selling candy days of the year revolve around Easter, Valentine's Day and Halloween, and it all started with a few bold pioneers. (Cooking, History, Documentary)

programme.title: The Food That Built America - Movie Theater Munchies
programme.desc: S6E2 - A struggling chocolate maker and a young theater assistant create the movie theater concession stand and launch the world's most iconic movie candies. (Cooking, History, Documentary)

programme.title: The Food That Built America - Clash of the Coffee
programme.desc: S4E5 - Two icons compete for America's coffee drinkers and forever change a worldwide, multi-billion-dollar industry. (Cooking, History, Documentary)

programme.title: The Food That Built America - Let Them Eat Snack Cakes
programme.desc: S3E11 - Martha Entenmann takes the reins of her late husband's baking company and grows it into a national powerhouse; a married couple bankrupt one bakery but succeed during their second time around with a revolutionary way to sell snack cakes. (Cooking, History, Documentary)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Food Fiascos
programme.desc: S1E6 - Snack on a feast of food horrors from the past; from radioactive energy drinks, to scandalous snacks made with Olestra, to the additives in your milk and bread, uncovering the things people once ate without a second thought. (Documentary)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Spectacular Stunts
programme.desc: S1E2 - A wild journey into the world of vintage daredevils who risked it all for a rush; from the enigmatic Human Fly to skateboard speed demons and diving horses, these stunts are as reckless as they are unforgettable. (Documentary)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Occupational Hazards
programme.desc: S1E8 - Uncovering the downright dangerous gigs of the past, from mercury-poisoned hatmakers to kids crawling through chimneys and projectionists fleeing fiery blazes. (Documentary)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Twisted Toys
programme.desc: S2E3 - Remember when playtime meant tempting fate?; from toy belts that fire speeding projectiles, to high-powered pogo sticks that send people soaring, to dolls that try to eat people alive, these playthings are made for kids, but their risks are anything but child's play; it's a mind-blowing, bone-rattling trip through the toys of yesteryear that remind people of a time when childhood was wild, free, and hazardous. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Anything for a Buck
programme.desc: S2E10 - When earning a paycheck meant risking life and limb. From dangling off skyscrapers without safety harnesses and riding runaway logs down raging rivers, to digging up corpses for cash and selling your own blood to scrape by, people once took unbelievable risks no paycheck could truly cover. Whether racing pizzas across town at breakneck speed or pulling off death-defying Hollywood stunts, people once did whatever it took to earn a living. (Documentary)

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler - Young & the Reckless (New)
programme.desc: S2E11 - When being young meant testing the limits of what our bodies could survive. From launching our bikes off homemade ramps and playing chicken in traffic, to using dangerous construction sites as our playground, childhood adventure was often intertwined with how far you were willing to go--and the consequences that came with it. programme.title: Runaway Bride

Gere is Ike Graham, a cynical, big-city newspaper columnist eager to write a tell-all story about Maggie. But the more Ike finds out about the skittish Maggie, the more he finds he's falling in love. - Julia Roberts, Richard Gere, Joan Cusack, Héctor Elizondo, Rita Wilson (Romantic comedy)

Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly. (Comedy, Docudrama)
